label: scam
title: Short: fake grandson, arrest, bail, secrecy, gift cards. Red by line 2

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Grandma, it's me. I'm in big trouble.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I have a cold. I was in a car accident, and the police arrested me. I need bail money right now.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Oh no! Should I call your mother?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: No, please don't tell Mom. Keep this between us. Buy Google Play gift cards, two thousand dollars, and read me the numbers.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Please hurry, Grandma. And don't hang up.
